description: Create an issue. type / priority / assignee / category / milestone are given by NAME (default type = the project's first, priority = Normal); parent = an issue key makes a child issue; other keys (description, dueDate, startDate, estimatedHours, …) go to the API as-is. Dry run unless send=true. In a CUSTOMER's space the summary and description follow the user's review mode, like add_comment.

attachments.description: Local file paths to upload and attach (images, documents, …). Uploaded only when send=true

send.description: false (default) = dry run: returns the exact request. true = actually send — only after the user approved it

space.description: Space name, as listed by list_spaces

name: create_issue
